---
title: Build on bimai
description: Add a tool, a procedure or a workflow, following one contract.
---

bimai is built to be built on. Whatever you add, whether a custom Revit connection, a Blender/Bonsai
bridge or a procedure your company uses, follows the same contract and immediately gets approvals,
evidence, tests and scheduling.

| You want to add | Build a | Start with |
|---|---|---|
| Access to a tool or data source | Connector | `/bimai:new-connector` |
| A repeatable BIM procedure | Pack | `/bimai:new-pack` |
| A chain of steps | Workflow | `/bimai:new-workflow` |
| A scheduled run | Automation | `/bimai:new-automation` |

The **Builder** role walks you through it, and `/bimai:certify` tells you which maturity level you reached.

**Documentation is part of done.** Every connector, pack, workflow and command ships with a page on
this site. See [Documentation](/docs/build/documentation).
